statements.statement: CARLA is an open-source urban driving simulator widely used for autonomous driving research.
It supports development, training, prototyping, and validation of autonomous driving models including perception and control.
CARLA provides flexible specification of sensor suites and environmental conditions.
CARLA includes free digital assets such as urban layouts, buildings, vehicles, pedestrians, and street signs created by a dedicated team of digital artists.
It enables controlled scenario evaluation of multiple autonomous driving approaches including classic modular pipelines, end-to-end imitation learning, and reinforcement learning.
